items.followUp: Write the truth table for the AND operator.

rubric.why: An OR truth table must show all four possible pairs of binary inputs.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for showing each input pair.

rubric.why: OR gives 1 when at least one input is 1, and gives 0 only when both inputs are 0.
rubric.description: Shows the correct output for each input pair.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for matching all four input pairs with their correct outputs.
